# Generated by forge. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

option(FORGE_UNIVERSAL "Build a universal (arm64 + x86_64) binary" OFF)
if(FORGE_UNIVERSAL)
  set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64;x86_64")
else()
  set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64")
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

project(hello VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX OBJCXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_executable(hello MACOSX_BUNDLE
  main.cpp
  actions.cpp
  cli_router.cpp
  ui_macos.mm)

target_compile_options(hello PRIVATE
  -Os -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -Wall -Wextra
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:OBJCXX>:-fobjc-arc>)
target_link_options(hello PRIVATE -Wl,-dead_strip)
target_link_libraries(hello PRIVATE "-framework Cocoa")

set_target_properties(hello PROPERTIES
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "hello"
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "local.forge.hello"
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION "0.1.0"
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING "0.1.0")

install(TARGETS hello BUNDLE DESTINATION .)

set(CPACK_GENERATOR DragNDrop)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME "hello")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION "0.1.0")
include(CPack)
